name: @local/dsh-ac-boot
description: A holographic mission-briefing opening sequence for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI. v0.17.0 choreographs the theater reveal: the map starts uncolored, a solid white-hot seed appears and rises, bursting a denser (240/200/96-ray) fan that fades quickly, the highlighted sector fill rises from below, and the bright point lingers solid before gradually dissipating, leaving only the key nodes. Procedural coastlines, lat/long graticule and satellite/plate rails complete the interface. The map is drawn entirely in SVG; Agnes supplies only the terrain relief and holographic table textures. Host contract unchanged (name + inject=['webServer'], splash rows only, read-only /acb/assets). Launch-scoped one-shot behaviour preserved.
